astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: IC 4592: The Blue Horsehead Reflection Nebula
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: Do you see the horse's head?   What you are seeing is not the famous Horsehead nebula toward Orion, but rather a fainter nebula that only takes on a familiar form with deeper imaging.  The main part of the here-imaged molecular cloud complex is  reflection nebula IC 4592.
